name: pine-forge
displayName: PineForge — Pine Script v6 Language Server, Linter & Formatter
description: PineForge: Pine Script v6 language support — LSP diagnostics, hovers, filtered completions, go-to-reference (TradingView docs), find references, outline, workspace symbols, signature help, rename (user symbols), format document, and quick fixes. TradingView remains authoritative for full compiler parity.

commands.title: Pine Script: Open v6 Reference Manual
PineForge: Suggest fix with Ollama (selection or line)
PineForge: Ask Ollama at cursor (output channel)
PineForge: Set Ollama API key (Secret Storage)

walkthroughs.title: PineForge
walkthroughs.description: Build, debug, and edit Pine Script v6 with the PineForge extension.

steps.title: Compile and launch
steps.description: Install dependencies, compile TypeScript, and start the Extension Development Host (F5).

steps.title: Open a .pine file
steps.description: Use a sample Pine file and confirm language features are active.

pineForge.maxNumberOfProblems.description: Maximum number of problems reported per file

pineForge.strictImplicitBoolIf.description: When enabled, report bare `if close`-style series-as-bool on the same line only (conservative); skips strings/comments, comparisons, and indexing tails.

pineForge.styleTradingViewHints.description: Information-level hints for common TradingView Pine style guide conventions (ordering, `Input` suffix on `input.*` LHS). Heuristic only; see docs/tradingview-style-guide.md.

pineForge.limitationHints.description: Information-level hints for TradingView platform limits we can only approximate (plot-count upper bound, many request.* sites). See docs/tradingview-limitations.md.

pineForge.tradingViewManualHints.description: Information-level hints tied to the TradingView User Manual *Errors and warnings* overview (e.g. CE10101-style bare `if identifier`). Heuristic only — see docs/tradingview-errors-overview.md.

pineForge.ollama.enabled.description: Enable PineForge Ollama features (commands and optional inline/list integrations). Sends selected or contextual source to your configured host when you run them.

pineForge.ollama.host.description: Ollama API base URL. Use https://ollama.com for Ollama Cloud (set API key via command).

pineForge.ollama.model.description: Model name for chat (default qwen3.5:4b for local Ollama; override or use a cloud model id with ollama.com).

pineForge.ollama.stream.description: Stream chat tokens to the PineForge AI output channel.

pineForge.ollama.inlineCompletions.description: Ghost-text inline completions from Ollama (non-streaming, separate from LSP symbol completions).

pineForge.ollama.inlineDebounceMs.description: Delay after typing before requesting inline AI (reduces request spam).

pineForge.ollama.inlineContextLines.description: Lines before / after the cursor included in the inline and "Ask AI" completion prompts.

pineForge.ollama.inlineMaxPromptChars.description: Upper bound on combined prefix+suffix characters sent for inline AI.

pineForge.ollama.inlineTimeoutMs.description: Hard timeout for each inline completion request.

pineForge.ollama.codeActionsInLightbulb.description: Show a Refactor ▸ PineForge AI code action that runs "suggest fix" for the current range (no network until you choose it).

pineForge.ollama.completionAskAiItem.description: Add an "Ask PineForge AI" entry to the completion list (runs the same cursor-context prompt as the command).
